chapters.title: Chapter 310
paragraphs: Rustle, rustle, rustle.
Five hundred bandits emerged behind Heavenly Axe.
But their overwhelming numbers weren’t the only reason Ju Hwaran’s face hardened.
Their momentum is different.
Those trying to cross the mountain and those blocking their way. Escort Bureaus and the Green Forest were inseparable.

An Escort Bureau couldn’t draw its swords every time it encountered bandits, so it would pay a set toll. The Green Forest, in turn, would accept a reasonable sum and withdraw, allowing both sides to save face. That had long been the custom.
But neither Heavenly Axe nor the bandits of Black Stone Stronghold showed any intention of backing down.
“You mean to spill blood after all...”
Heavenly Axe curled his lips at Ju Hwaran’s words.
“You’re pretty sharp for a little bitch. That’s right. Today, I intend to stain Black Stone Mountain with blood.”
“Little bitch?”
“What? Don’t like it? Would you rather I called you an old bitch?”
“I am the Young Bureau Head of the Yongbong Escort Bureau. Show me the same courtesy I’m showing you.”
Ju Hwaran’s beautiful, brush-painted eyebrows shot upward.
She was the bureau chief’s only child, but that didn’t mean she had been raised pampered and sheltered.
She had swung a sword since childhood until calluses formed across her palms. She had eaten and slept on the road alongside the escorts, watching and learning.
People fawned over Ju Hwaran as one of the Three Flowers of Jiangbei, but she was no hothouse flower.
“What a brazen little bitch. And what will you do if I refuse?”
“Then...”
Ju Hwaran—the Dagger Hidden Flower—continued with a frosty expression.
“You’ll have to die at the hands of this little bitch.”
“What? Huh... Hahahahaha!”
It took a while for Heavenly Axe’s wild laughter to subside.
“You’ve got more backbone than I expected. I like you.”
“Why would I care if some old bandit likes me?”
“You’ve got quite the sharp tongue. Aren’t you worried about what comes next?”
“Why are you doing this in the first place?”
“Why? A bandit says he intends to kill and rob you. Does he need some special reason?”
Ju Hwaran bit down hard on her lip at his brazen reply.
“If word of this gets out, it will put the Green Forest Alliance in a difficult position.”
“A difficult position?”
“The Yongbong Escort Bureau is part of the orthodox faction. The orthodox Murim won’t stand idly by.”
“Part of the orthodox faction, are you? Then I suppose that would be a problem.”
Heavenly Axe stroked his shaggy beard and continued.
“So I’ll do my best to make sure word never gets out. A secret can’t hurt anyone if it never leaks, can it?”
Silencing the witnesses.

Realizing what Heavenly Axe meant, Ju Hwaran tightened her grip on her sword hilt. Chief Escort Heo Jun stepped forward in her place and shouted, “One hundred silver nyang! Clear the road, and I’ll give you one hundred silver nyang. We’ll consider today’s matter closed, so let this end here!”
“Oh? One hundred nyang? Silver nyang, at that?”
“Of course. Have I ever made an empty promise?”
“No, you haven’t. This is hardly our first meeting. Brother Heo’s word can be trusted.”
Chief Escort Heo Jun had devoted nearly thirty years to the Yongbong Escort Bureau.

The Yongbong Escort Bureau was a major Escort Bureau based in Shaanxi. Heo Jun had successfully completed hundreds of escort journeys, large and small, and crossed Black Stone Mountain so often that he had become acquainted with the Green Forest’s Stronghold Lords. That included Heavenly Axe, who had taken command of Black Stone Stronghold five years earlier.
“That’s five times the usual toll. Enough of this nasty joke. Clear the road.”
“A nasty joke? Is that what this looked like?”
Heavenly Axe let out a hearty laugh. Then his face abruptly turned cold.
“There’s a limit to how much of a fool you can take me for. Brother Heo, if you want to bargain, offer a fair price.”
“A-A fair price?”

“Even the dogs in my stronghold know that the goods you’re transporting include a Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng. We could sell it as stolen goods today and easily get several thousand silver nyang for it. Isn’t that right?”
Several people’s eyelids began to twitch, including Ju Hwaran’s and Heo Jun’s.
A thousand-year snow ginseng was an elixir that could grant a full jiazi of internal energy if completely digested.
The existence of the thousand-year snow ginseng, which had been secretly commissioned by the Zhongnan Sect, was a top-level secret known by only a handful of people within the Yongbong Escort Bureau.
How had word reached Heavenly Axe?
None of it was a coincidence.
The past four months of the escort journey flashed through Ju Hwaran’s mind.
The bandits and nameless wandering martial artists who had attacked them as if they were mortal enemies.
They had fought dozens of battles, large and small, and suffered terrible losses—all because information about the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng had leaked.
Who was it?
The thought had occurred to her before, but she had forced her suspicions down.
What had kept her going through the misfortunes that had piled upon her over the past two years was the people around her.
They were the greatest inheritance her grandfather had passed to her father, and her father to her.
Even as the Yongbong Escort Bureau lost its former glory and gradually declined, they had stayed. Despite her repeated failures, they had continued to show her unstinting trust and support.
That was why she hadn’t wanted to suspect them. Why she had refused to doubt them.
But now...
Ju Hwaran swept an empty gaze over her surroundings.
Chief Escort Heo Jun stood frozen, looking as betrayed as she felt. Then she saw the other three people who knew about the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng.
They were the three outstanding escort captains who represented the Yongbong Escort Bureau—the men collectively known as the Dragon-Phoenix Three Escorts.
Seokchil. Noh Piljung.
Ju Hwaran’s gaze passed over the two middle-aged escort captains, both nearing forty, then turned to the last man.
Song Ilseom.
Unlike the other two members of the Dragon-Phoenix Three Escorts, Song Ilseom was tall and strikingly handsome.
Barely past thirty, he had joined the Yongbong Escort Bureau as an escort ten years earlier and risen rapidly through the ranks.

Though he occasionally revealed his rough temper, his outstanding martial arts had led numerous escort journeys to success. That was why, despite his youth, he had earned a place among the Dragon-Phoenix Three Escorts.
But Song Ilseom was also the subject of endless gossip.
“They say he used to be a wandering martial artist. A fixer, no less.”
“Apparently, there was nothing he wouldn’t do as long as he got paid.”
“That’s not all. Everyone says he’s deeply in love with the Young Lady. Mihyang told me that whenever he gets the chance, he slips into the inner courtyard and wanders around the garden.”
“I heard he joined the Escort Bureau because of the Young Lady... Everyone knows the Chief wanted an escort as his son-in-law, after all.”
Ju Hwaran knew the rumors surrounding Song Ilseom.
She also knew that most of them were true.
Song Ilseom’s blatant stares had made her uncomfortable more than once. Indeed, that was why she had agonized over whether to bring him on this escort journey.
But surely Captain Song wouldn’t...
The moment Ju Hwaran’s gaze settled on Song Ilseom’s face, his thick, fierce-looking eyebrows shot upward.
Flash—whoosh!
“Hwaran!”
Three things happened at once.
A dagger shot from Song Ilseom’s sleeve.
At the same time, Chief Escort Heo Jun hurriedly stepped in front of Ju Hwaran.
And finally—
Thud!
“Ghk... Grrrk.”
More than twenty jang away, a Black Stone Stronghold bandit collapsed with the dagger buried in his throat.
Bloody foam spilled from the bandit’s mouth. He convulsed, then went still.
A frigid silence descended over the scene. It seemed as though it might last forever, until Song Ilseom shattered it with a single shout.
“No more talking! Fight as if your lives depend on it!”
His fierce cry carried far on the night wind.
Ju Hwaran, Heo Jun, and everyone else from the Yongbong Escort Bureau realized the same thing.
Negotiations were over.
Now they would have to fight to the death against hundreds of enemies who had suffered an unexpected opening attack.
“Song Ilseom! What have you done?”
At Chief Escort Heo Jun’s furious shout, Song Ilseom raised his willow-leaf saber and rested it across his shoulder.
“What do you think? It’s a little late to ask that now, isn’t it?”
“You bastard...”
“He’s right.”
Ju Hwaran spoke calmly as she gripped her sword hilt.
Unfortunately, Song Ilseom was telling the truth.
Heavenly Axe was already advancing toward them, radiating a terrifying aura.
He had lost one of his men without having time to do anything. Flames poured from his bulging eyes.
“I’ll slaughter every last one of you.”
Hissssss!
Red qi writhed along the blade of his lowered axe.
The Green Forest Alliance had countless members, but Heavenly Axe ranked twentieth among them—a Peak master.
Buoyed by their leader’s aura, the five hundred Green Forest bandits growled like wild beasts.
“Kill them all!”
“This will be your grave!”
Listening to their furious cries, Ju Hwaran looked up at the star-studded night sky.
This may be my last escort journey.
Of the seventy-odd people who remained, barely forty were escorts once the caravan porters were excluded.
Everyone was exhausted from the long escort journey. The conditions were far too harsh for them to face Heavenly Axe and five hundred Green Forest bandits.
Can I do this?
Thud, thud, thud.
The ground trembled beneath hundreds of footsteps. The battle she had tried to avoid but could no longer escape was about to begin.
All we can do now is fight to the very end.
She had to get at least one person out alive.
Just as Ju Hwaran was about to face forward again, she noticed a star she had never seen before.
Among the countless stars embroidered across the pitch-black sky, one shone brighter than all the rest. It cast its radiance for the briefest moment, then vanished.
And in the next instant, something no one could have expected happened.
“Don’t fight, everyone! No matter how badly you get along, something terrible will happen if you fight!”
At the sudden shout, everyone stopped dead. Hundreds of heads whipped toward the source of the voice.
The world lay submerged in darkness.
Four figures stood atop a hill, faintly illuminated by the moonlight.
Soon, quiet voices drifted down.
“What are they?”
“They look like bandits. The people on the other side seem to be from an Escort Bureau.”
“No, I can see they’re bandits. I’m asking why they’re fighting out here in the middle of the night. We’re already busy enough to drop dead.”
“They look busier than we are.”
“Mujin, has it been long since you were hit?”
“No. About half an hour.”
Smack!
“Gibang, do you know who they are?”
“Of course.”
“Help me out, Speed Beggar.”
“Judging by the flag, they’re from the Yongbong Escort Bureau. The other side is Black Stone Stronghold, led by Heavenly Axe.”
“Never heard of either one. But for some reason, Heavenly Axe sounds familiar.”

“The Yongbong Escort Bureau was once counted among the Ten Great Escort Bureaus of the martial world, and Heavenly Axe is a Peak master ranked among the Green Forest Alliance’s top twenty. He wields a single axe like a demon...”
“No, wait. You don’t mean that Heavenly Axe, do you?”
“You know Heavenly Axe?”
“I definitely killed him... Did he catch the reincarnation bus or something? Wait here. I’m going to get a look at his face.”
“Benefactor! What’s a reincarnation bus?”

What is that?

Hundreds of people facing one another in the darkness, weapons in hand.

Step, step. Stop.

The young man finally stopped and slowly turned his head.

He had just called Heavenly Axe—a Peak master counted among the Green Forest Alliance’s foremost experts—a bastard.

The next instant, the axe in his hand crashed down toward the crown of the young man’s head.
Whoosh—crash!
Condensed qi collided.
A flexible sword intercepted the axe blade, which shimmered with red qi.

She, too, was a swordswoman who had reached the Peak. But Heavenly Axe possessed both tremendous natural strength and far greater experience. She was nowhere near strong enough to withstand him.
“Ghk! Young Hero, hurry and run—!”
“You little bitch, how dare you!”
Clang, clang, clang!
The two blades locked together, sending sparks flying.
The enormous axe slowly bore down on her.
Just as Heo Jun and Song Ilseom charged forward to help Ju Hwaran, the lips of the young man standing as still as stone parted.
“Say one thing for me.”
“...What?”
“Help me. Just say those words.”
Is he out of his mind?
The thought flashed through Ju Hwaran’s head.
The young man had not even been able to react to Heavenly Axe’s attack. If she had not blocked it with her flexible sword, he would have been cut in half and killed without a chance.
But regardless of what she thought, the words were already leaving her mouth.
“Help me!”
Then she saw it.
The faint smile forming at the corner of the young man’s lips.
A voice so quiet that only she could hear it reached her ears.
“Quest accepted.”
Whoosh!
A scorching wind erupted without warning.
And Ju Hwaran felt an endless warmth.

sentences.text: Rustle, rustle, rustle.
Five hundred bandits emerged behind Heavenly Axe.
But their overwhelming numbers weren’t the only reason Ju Hwaran’s face hardened.
Their momentum is different.
Those trying to cross the mountain and those blocking their way.
Escort Bureaus and the Green Forest were inseparable.
An Escort Bureau couldn’t draw its swords every time it encountered bandits, so it would pay a set toll.
The Green Forest, in turn, would accept a reasonable sum and withdraw, allowing both sides to save face.
That had long been the custom.
But neither Heavenly Axe nor the bandits of Black Stone Stronghold showed any intention of backing down.
“You mean to spill blood after all...”
Heavenly Axe curled his lips at Ju Hwaran’s words.
“You’re pretty sharp for a little bitch.
That’s right.
Today, I intend to stain Black Stone Mountain with blood.”
“Little bitch?”
“What?
Don’t like it?
Would you rather I called you an old bitch?”
“I am the Young Bureau Head of the Yongbong Escort Bureau.
Show me the same courtesy I’m showing you.”
Ju Hwaran’s beautiful, brush-painted eyebrows shot upward.
She was the bureau chief’s only child, but that didn’t mean she had been raised pampered and sheltered.
She had swung a sword since childhood until calluses formed across her palms.
She had eaten and slept on the road alongside the escorts, watching and learning.
People fawned over Ju Hwaran as one of the Three Flowers of Jiangbei, but she was no hothouse flower.
“What a brazen little bitch.
And what will you do if I refuse?”
“Then...”
Ju Hwaran—the Dagger Hidden Flower—continued with a frosty expression.
“You’ll have to die at the hands of this little bitch.”
“What?
Huh...
Hahahahaha!”
It took a while for Heavenly Axe’s wild laughter to subside.
“You’ve got more backbone than I expected.
I like you.”
“Why would I care if some old bandit likes me?”
“You’ve got quite the sharp tongue.
Aren’t you worried about what comes next?”
“Why are you doing this in the first place?”
“Why?
A bandit says he intends to kill and rob you.
Does he need some special reason?”
Ju Hwaran bit down hard on her lip at his brazen reply.
“If word of this gets out, it will put the Green Forest Alliance in a difficult position.”
“A difficult position?”
“The Yongbong Escort Bureau is part of the orthodox faction.
The orthodox Murim won’t stand idly by.”
“Part of the orthodox faction, are you?
Then I suppose that would be a problem.”
Heavenly Axe stroked his shaggy beard and continued.
“So I’ll do my best to make sure word never gets out.
A secret can’t hurt anyone if it never leaks, can it?”
Silencing the witnesses.
Realizing what Heavenly Axe meant, Ju Hwaran tightened her grip on her sword hilt.
Chief Escort Heo Jun stepped forward in her place and shouted, “One hundred silver nyang!
Clear the road, and I’ll give you one hundred silver nyang.
We’ll consider today’s matter closed, so let this end here!”
“Oh?
One hundred nyang?
Silver nyang, at that?”
“Of course.
Have I ever made an empty promise?”
“No, you haven’t.
This is hardly our first meeting.
Brother Heo’s word can be trusted.”
Chief Escort Heo Jun had devoted nearly thirty years to the Yongbong Escort Bureau.
The Yongbong Escort Bureau was a major Escort Bureau based in Shaanxi.
Heo Jun had successfully completed hundreds of escort journeys, large and small, and crossed Black Stone Mountain so often that he had become acquainted with the Green Forest’s Stronghold Lords.
That included Heavenly Axe, who had taken command of Black Stone Stronghold five years earlier.
“That’s five times the usual toll.
Enough of this nasty joke.
Clear the road.”
“A nasty joke?
Is that what this looked like?”
Heavenly Axe let out a hearty laugh.
Then his face abruptly turned cold.
“There’s a limit to how much of a fool you can take me for.
Brother Heo, if you want to bargain, offer a fair price.”
“A-A fair price?”
“Even the dogs in my stronghold know that the goods you’re transporting include a Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng.
We could sell it as stolen goods today and easily get several thousand silver nyang for it.
Isn’t that right?”
Several people’s eyelids began to twitch, including Ju Hwaran’s and Heo Jun’s.
A thousand-year snow ginseng was an elixir that could grant a full jiazi of internal energy if completely digested.
The existence of the thousand-year snow ginseng, which had been secretly commissioned by the Zhongnan Sect, was a top-level secret known by only a handful of people within the Yongbong Escort Bureau.
How had word reached Heavenly Axe?
None of it was a coincidence.
The past four months of the escort journey flashed through Ju Hwaran’s mind.
The bandits and nameless wandering martial artists who had attacked them as if they were mortal enemies.
They had fought dozens of battles, large and small, and suffered terrible losses—all because information about the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng had leaked.
Who was it?
The thought had occurred to her before, but she had forced her suspicions down.
What had kept her going through the misfortunes that had piled upon her over the past two years was the people around her.
They were the greatest inheritance her grandfather had passed to her father, and her father to her.
Even as the Yongbong Escort Bureau lost its former glory and gradually declined, they had stayed.
Despite her repeated failures, they had continued to show her unstinting trust and support.
That was why she hadn’t wanted to suspect them.
Why she had refused to doubt them.
But now...
Ju Hwaran swept an empty gaze over her surroundings.
Chief Escort Heo Jun stood frozen, looking as betrayed as she felt.
Then she saw the other three people who knew about the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng.
They were the three outstanding escort captains who represented the Yongbong Escort Bureau—the men collectively known as the Dragon-Phoenix Three Escorts.
Seokchil.
Noh Piljung.
Ju Hwaran’s gaze passed over the two middle-aged escort captains, both nearing forty, then turned to the last man.
Song Ilseom.
Unlike the other two members of the Dragon-Phoenix Three Escorts, Song Ilseom was tall and strikingly handsome.
Barely past thirty, he had joined the Yongbong Escort Bureau as an escort ten years earlier and risen rapidly through the ranks.
Though he occasionally revealed his rough temper, his outstanding martial arts had led numerous escort journeys to success.
That was why, despite his youth, he had earned a place among the Dragon-Phoenix Three Escorts.
But Song Ilseom was also the subject of endless gossip.
“They say he used to be a wandering martial artist.
A fixer, no less.”
“Apparently, there was nothing he wouldn’t do as long as he got paid.”
“That’s not all.
Everyone says he’s deeply in love with the Young Lady.
Mihyang told me that whenever he gets the chance, he slips into the inner courtyard and wanders around the garden.”
“I heard he joined the Escort Bureau because of the Young Lady...
Everyone knows the Chief wanted an escort as his son-in-law, after all.”
Ju Hwaran knew the rumors surrounding Song Ilseom.
She also knew that most of them were true.
Song Ilseom’s blatant stares had made her uncomfortable more than once.
Indeed, that was why she had agonized over whether to bring him on this escort journey.
But surely Captain Song wouldn’t...
The moment Ju Hwaran’s gaze settled on Song Ilseom’s face, his thick, fierce-looking eyebrows shot upward.
Flash—whoosh!
“Hwaran!”
Three things happened at once.
A dagger shot from Song Ilseom’s sleeve.
At the same time, Chief Escort Heo Jun hurriedly stepped in front of Ju Hwaran.
And finally—
Thud!
“Ghk...
Grrrk.”
More than twenty jang away, a Black Stone Stronghold bandit collapsed with the dagger buried in his throat.
Bloody foam spilled from the bandit’s mouth.
He convulsed, then went still.
A frigid silence descended over the scene.
It seemed as though it might last forever, until Song Ilseom shattered it with a single shout.
“No more talking!
Fight as if your lives depend on it!”
His fierce cry carried far on the night wind.
Ju Hwaran, Heo Jun, and everyone else from the Yongbong Escort Bureau realized the same thing.
Negotiations were over.
Now they would have to fight to the death against hundreds of enemies who had suffered an unexpected opening attack.
“Song Ilseom!
What have you done?”
At Chief Escort Heo Jun’s furious shout, Song Ilseom raised his willow-leaf saber and rested it across his shoulder.
“What do you think?
It’s a little late to ask that now, isn’t it?”
“You bastard...”
“He’s right.”
Ju Hwaran spoke calmly as she gripped her sword hilt.
Unfortunately, Song Ilseom was telling the truth.
Heavenly Axe was already advancing toward them, radiating a terrifying aura.
He had lost one of his men without having time to do anything.
Flames poured from his bulging eyes.
“I’ll slaughter every last one of you.”
Hissssss!
Red qi writhed along the blade of his lowered axe.
The Green Forest Alliance had countless members, but Heavenly Axe ranked twentieth among them—a Peak master.
Buoyed by their leader’s aura, the five hundred Green Forest bandits growled like wild beasts.
“Kill them all!”
“This will be your grave!”
Listening to their furious cries, Ju Hwaran looked up at the star-studded night sky.
This may be my last escort journey.
Of the seventy-odd people who remained, barely forty were escorts once the caravan porters were excluded.
Everyone was exhausted from the long escort journey.
The conditions were far too harsh for them to face Heavenly Axe and five hundred Green Forest bandits.
Can I do this?
Thud, thud, thud.
The ground trembled beneath hundreds of footsteps.
The battle she had tried to avoid but could no longer escape was about to begin.
All we can do now is fight to the very end.
She had to get at least one person out alive.
Just as Ju Hwaran was about to face forward again, she noticed a star she had never seen before.
Among the countless stars embroidered across the pitch-black sky, one shone brighter than all the rest.
It cast its radiance for the briefest moment, then vanished.
And in the next instant, something no one could have expected happened.
“Don’t fight, everyone!
No matter how badly you get along, something terrible will happen if you fight!”
At the sudden shout, everyone stopped dead.
Hundreds of heads whipped toward the source of the voice.
The world lay submerged in darkness.

chapters.title: Chapter 311
paragraphs: “Quest accepted.”
Ding.
System You have accepted the Sudden Quest Crisis of the Yongbong Escort Bureau!
You’ve really grown up, Jin Taekyung. Now you can even create Quests on your own.
I smiled proudly and extended my right hand. My palm, glowing red with the heat of the Flame Divine Palm, struck the side of the axe at terrifying speed.
Boom!
The deafening impact sent Heavenly Axe’s massive body sliding backward. He staggered back three jang, his face twisted with confusion and fury.
“W-What is the meaning of this...?”
“What do you think? You messed with the wrong guy.”
I grinned and looked Heavenly Axe up and down.
This wasn’t the fake Level 10 Heavenly Axe I’d encountered long ago. This was the real Heavenly Axe, a whopping Level 90.
Wow. The real thing really is different.
He was much larger, his face so vicious that it would have been a crime for him not to be a bandit, and his martial arts were on an entirely different level.
The sight of him brought old memories bubbling back to the surface.
I gained quite a bit of Fame when that false rumor about me taking him down spread.
That was around the time people within the Jin Family of Taiyuan began to reevaluate me.
They had mistaken the fake Heavenly Axe for the real one and spread the rumor, allowing me to gradually shed the stigma of being the family’s disgrace.
Damn, it feels like yesterday.
Heavenly Axe glared at me warily as I sank into nostalgia.
“Who... the hell are you?”
“Me? The man who’s going to kill you twice.”
“W-What did you say?”
“It’s a long story.”
“Kill me twice? What kind of bullshit is that...? Wait. Could it be...?”
Heavenly Axe’s voice abruptly cut off.
He stared at me, his face rigid. Then a thunderous cry burst from his lips.
“The Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi!”
“Huh? You know me?”
“I heard a rumor like that about a year ago... No, that’s not the point.”
Heavenly Axe continued in a stammer, the way he addressed me already changing.
“A-Are you truly Young Hero Jin Taekyung of the Jin Family of Taiyuan?”
“I’m not a Young Hero, but I am Jin Taekyung.”
When I nodded readily, startled gasps escaped from all around us.
Bandits and escorts alike stared at me in shock. The gaze from beside me was especially intense.
System Level 88: Ju Hwaran
Her smooth lips parted slightly, and a clear voice flowed out.
“You’re... the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi?”
“Hmm. That’s what people call me.”
She stared up at me with wide black eyes, then abruptly gave me a formal fist-and-palm salute.
“I am Ju Hwaran, Young Bureau Head of the Yongbong Escort Bureau. It is an honor to meet you, Young Hero Jin.”
“Ah, yes. Nice to meet you.”
I guess I’m more famous than I thought.
I’d never expected to run into hundreds of people who knew me on a mountain road in the dead of night, thousands of li from Shanxi Province.
Even less had I expected the most beautiful woman I’d seen in all my twenty-eight years to recognize me first.
Can a person really look like this?
There was no way to properly describe Ju Hwaran’s beauty with simple words like pretty or beautiful.
I was still staring at her, cursing my inadequate vocabulary, when—
“Ahem. Come to think of it, don’t we have repairs to do at the stronghold today?”
“Y-You’re right, Chief. I completely forgot.”
Amid awkward coughs, hundreds of bandits began cautiously edging away.
I turned to find Heavenly Axe and the Green Forest bandits of Black Stone Stronghold slowly backing off.
I waved at Heavenly Axe.
“Hey, Axe.”
His body stiffened.
“Yeah. Our Axe. Where are you going?”
His expression was a sight to behold. It twisted, smoothed out, then twisted again.
Rising fury warred with his patience, leaving his face twisted into a ridiculous grimace. Heavenly Axe barely managed to squeeze out a reply.
“I have some business to attend to at the stronghold, so I should be going.”
“Exactly. Why are you leaving without permission?”
A chilly silence settled over the clearing. Heavenly Axe’s hand turned white around the haft of his weapon, but that was as far as it went.
We had exchanged only a single blow.
But Heavenly Axe—and everyone else present—must have realized it. I was a master on a higher level than him.
Of course, that wasn’t the only source of the fear making Heavenly Axe hesitate.
“W-Where is the Fire King?”
Where else? Sleeping soundly on the pack frame strapped to my back.
I had covered him with layers of fur in case anything happened. No one could possibly imagine that the terrifying Fire King was lying unconscious on the pack frame.
Besides, no one can find out that Old Master has collapsed.
If that happened, all kinds of vermin, including Dark Heaven, would come crawling out of the woodwork.
I concealed my thoughts and laughed quietly.
“Why do you ask about my Master?”
“I only asked because I wanted to meet him.”
“Why? Are you close to my Master?”
“Well, he is someone I’ve always respected...”
“If you ever do meet him, don’t say that. He’ll be offended if a bandit bastard like you pretends to be close to him. He’ll start by breaking three or four of your ribs.”
“...Your joke is in poor taste.”
“Does it sound like a joke?”
Heavenly Axe bit down hard on his lip and rolled his eyes.
His gaze swept over me, Ju Hwaran and the other members of the Yongbong Escort Bureau, then the faces of the Bermuda Triangle slowly descending the hill. Finally, his eyes returned to me.
“Then he isn’t here?”
“What if he isn’t?”
“If that’s the case...”
Swish. Clunk.
Heavenly Axe raised his axe and rested it on his shoulder.
“Then that changes things considerably.”
“Like the way you’re talking now?”
“It was exhausting, humoring a young punk like you.”
“That’s strange. Nothing seems to have changed whether my Master is here or not.”
“That’s because you’re a greenhorn who knows nothing about the ways of the world.”
“How so?”
“I admit your martial arts are more impressive than I expected. But don’t make the mistake of thinking you’re your Master’s equal.”
Heavenly Axe raised one hand, his face filled with contempt.
At once, nearly five hundred Green Forest bandits lifted their weapons and stepped forward.
The mere fact that the Fire King was not present seemed to have restored their confidence.
“The Fire King, Jeok Cheongang, is undoubtedly a master beyond the human realm. But can you really turn the tide of this battle all by yourself?”
“Hmm.”
I looked around.
There were only a little more than seventy people from the Yongbong Escort Bureau.
Half were caravan porters who didn’t know so much as a single move of martial arts, and even the escorts who would have to fight were visibly exhausted.
By contrast, Heavenly Axe commanded nearly five hundred Green Forest bandits.
They had more than ten times as many fighters. Heavenly Axe certainly had reason to be confident.
But...
“I might as well turn it around while I have the chance.”
“Hahaha! Go ahead and try.”
“That’s the plan.”
The smile vanished from Heavenly Axe’s lips.
By then, I had already crossed five jang in a single step and thrown my fist.
Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist.
Vroooom.
Compressed air exploded outward. The wind split, and Extreme Yang heat surged forward.
The same strike that had brought down an unnamed cliff on Mount Song shot toward the five hundred Green Forest bandits massed together like a swarm of ants.
Heavenly Axe stood at their head.
Baaaaang!
A roar split the sky, sending clouds of dust and steam billowing upward.
Ding. Ding. Ding.
System notifications continued boring into my ears without pause.
These bandits were too low-Level to grant me any EXP. I had neither the need nor any reason to use my spear.
I simply unleashed my martial arts indiscriminately at the enemies beyond the chaotic fog.
Baaaaang!
I tore, struck, and smashed everything in my path.
Blood and screams flooded the shattered ground as it heaved like it had been struck by an artillery barrage.
“Gaaaaah!”
“Kill him!”
“He’s over there!”
Whoooosh! Thud!
Dozens of blades came flying too late and buried themselves in the innocent ground.
Their every movement was sluggish. I could clearly see the exact path each weapon would take.
This is easy. Almost bizarrely easy.
Crack!
My own movements, by contrast, were precise and carried tremendous destructive power. Each time I pressed forward without hesitation, three or four screams rang out.
The panicked bandits could no longer distinguish friend from foe. They simply swung their weapons like madmen.
Shhk! Slash!
“Gaaah! You crazy bastard!”
“W-Wangpal?”
“Yeah, it’s me! It’s me, you damned bastard!”
“Sorry. I thought you were him...”
I whispered into the flustered bandit’s ear.
“This time, it is me.”
Crunch!
I seized his neck and twisted with exactly as much force and speed as necessary.
His body crumpled without so much as a scream.
Before it touched the ground, I was already moving again.
Flamefire Path.
The Fire Gate Clan’s signature cultivation technique.
I kicked off the ground and surged forward, a tail of fire piercing the haze.
For an instant, the surroundings lit up, revealing a giant man measuring eight cheok.
Our gazes met through the air.
“There you are.”
“Jin Taekyung, you bastard...”
Grind.
Heavenly Axe ground his teeth as I stepped toward him.
I unleashed the Flame Divine Palm with all my internal energy behind it.
Red qi streamed from the enormous axe Heavenly Axe brought down with the momentum of splitting a person in two.
A lionlike roar burst from his mouth.
“Die!”
Whoooosh! Boom!
An immense wave of energy whirled outward from the collision.
We were so close that I could feel his breath against my cheek. My cold, impassive face was reflected in Heavenly Axe’s bulging eyes.
So were the broken axe and my hand, which had pierced through the weapon and his chest to emerge from his back.
Fwoosh!
No blood gushed out like a waterfall.
The heat of the Flame Divine Palm had already vaporized it.
Heavenly Axe’s lips, cracked like a drought-stricken field, moved weakly.
“Y-You... just what...”
“Why? You told me to turn things around.”
Shhk.
With those words, I pulled my hand from his chest.
His entire body had been burned and melted after he failed to block the opening strike of the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist.
Heavenly Axe looked down at his charred-black chest and muttered in a broken voice.
“This... can’t...”
The unfinished words became Heavenly Axe’s last.
Thud.
As his eight-cheok frame collapsed, a System notification rang out.
System You have defeated Level 93 Bangyeol! - You have completed Defeat Heavenly Axe! - You have gained a substantial amount of EXP!
Whoooosh.
Just then, a gust of wind swept around Black Stone Mountain and descended into the clearing.
The pale haze scattered, revealing the scene beneath it. Everyone’s eyes widened.
“This can’t be!”
Bangyeol, the Heavenly Axe.
Ranked twentieth in the Green Forest Alliance, he had been a Peak master counted among the foremost of the countless Green Forest bandits scattered across the continent.
Now he was dead.
The corpses of more than a hundred bandits slain in the melee lay scattered throughout the clearing.
The four hundred survivors stared at me with fear-filled eyes.
No. Everyone who had witnessed the scene was crying out.
“The Fire King...!”
The Fire King, Jeok Cheongang.
Fifty years ago, in an unnamed wilderness, he had annihilated a thousand Demonic Cultists—a martial artist who could stand against a thousand men alone.
The legend of the Fire Gate Clan had been proven through the Fire King’s myth.
And now, its spark had passed to me.
“Choose. Die here, or...”
My entire body burned hot. Extreme Yang heat flowed between my teeth, sending white steam billowing from my mouth.
I stared at my enemies with flames burning in my eyes.
“Kneel. Every last one of you.”
Clang.
Beginning with a single sword someone dropped helplessly, more than four hundred weapons rolled across the ground.
System You have completed Subdue Black Stone Stronghold! - You have successfully completed the Quest Crisis of the Yongbong Escort Bureau! - You have gained a substantial amount of EXP! Level Up!
The cheerful chime announced the end of the battle.

sentences.text: “Quest accepted.”
Ding.
System You have accepted the Sudden Quest Crisis of the Yongbong Escort Bureau!
You’ve really grown up, Jin Taekyung.
Now you can even create Quests on your own.
I smiled proudly and extended my right hand.
My palm, glowing red with the heat of the Flame Divine Palm, struck the side of the axe at terrifying speed.
Boom!
The deafening impact sent Heavenly Axe’s massive body sliding backward.
He staggered back three jang, his face twisted with confusion and fury.
“W-What is the meaning of this...?”
“What do you think?
You messed with the wrong guy.”
I grinned and looked Heavenly Axe up and down.
This wasn’t the fake Level 10 Heavenly Axe I’d encountered long ago.
This was the real Heavenly Axe, a whopping Level 90.
Wow.
The real thing really is different.
He was much larger, his face so vicious that it would have been a crime for him not to be a bandit, and his martial arts were on an entirely different level.
The sight of him brought old memories bubbling back to the surface.
I gained quite a bit of Fame when that false rumor about me taking him down spread.
That was around the time people within the Jin Family of Taiyuan began to reevaluate me.
They had mistaken the fake Heavenly Axe for the real one and spread the rumor, allowing me to gradually shed the stigma of being the family’s disgrace.
Damn, it feels like yesterday.
Heavenly Axe glared at me warily as I sank into nostalgia.
“Who... the hell are you?”
“Me?
The man who’s going to kill you twice.”
“W-What did you say?”
“It’s a long story.”
“Kill me twice?
What kind of bullshit is that...?
Wait.
Could it be...?”
Heavenly Axe’s voice abruptly cut off.
He stared at me, his face rigid.
Then a thunderous cry burst from his lips.
“The Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi!”
“Huh?
You know me?”
“I heard a rumor like that about a year ago...
No, that’s not the point.”
Heavenly Axe continued in a stammer, the way he addressed me already changing.
“A-Are you truly Young Hero Jin Taekyung of the Jin Family of Taiyuan?”
“I’m not a Young Hero, but I am Jin Taekyung.”
When I nodded readily, startled gasps escaped from all around us.
Bandits and escorts alike stared at me in shock.
The gaze from beside me was especially intense.
System Level 88: Ju Hwaran
Her smooth lips parted slightly, and a clear voice flowed out.
“You’re... the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi?”
“Hmm.
That’s what people call me.”
She stared up at me with wide black eyes, then abruptly gave me a formal fist-and-palm salute.
“I am Ju Hwaran, Young Bureau Head of the Yongbong Escort Bureau.
It is an honor to meet you, Young Hero Jin.”
“Ah, yes.
Nice to meet you.”
I guess I’m more famous than I thought.
I’d never expected to run into hundreds of people who knew me on a mountain road in the dead of night, thousands of li from Shanxi Province.
Even less had I expected the most beautiful woman I’d seen in all my twenty-eight years to recognize me first.
Can a person really look like this?
There was no way to properly describe Ju Hwaran’s beauty with simple words like pretty or beautiful.
I was still staring at her, cursing my inadequate vocabulary, when—
“Ahem.
Come to think of it, don’t we have repairs to do at the stronghold today?”
“Y-You’re right, Chief.
I completely forgot.”
Amid awkward coughs, hundreds of bandits began cautiously edging away.
I turned to find Heavenly Axe and the Green Forest bandits of Black Stone Stronghold slowly backing off.
I waved at Heavenly Axe.
“Hey, Axe.”
His body stiffened.
“Yeah.
Our Axe.
Where are you going?”
His expression was a sight to behold.
It twisted, smoothed out, then twisted again.
Rising fury warred with his patience, leaving his face twisted into a ridiculous grimace.
Heavenly Axe barely managed to squeeze out a reply.
“I have some business to attend to at the stronghold, so I should be going.”
“Exactly.
Why are you leaving without permission?”
A chilly silence settled over the clearing.
Heavenly Axe’s hand turned white around the haft of his weapon, but that was as far as it went.
We had exchanged only a single blow.
But Heavenly Axe—and everyone else present—must have realized it.
I was a master on a higher level than him.
Of course, that wasn’t the only source of the fear making Heavenly Axe hesitate.
“W-Where is the Fire King?”
Where else?
Sleeping soundly on the pack frame strapped to my back.
I had covered him with layers of fur in case anything happened.
No one could possibly imagine that the terrifying Fire King was lying unconscious on the pack frame.
Besides, no one can find out that Old Master has collapsed.
If that happened, all kinds of vermin, including Dark Heaven, would come crawling out of the woodwork.
I concealed my thoughts and laughed quietly.
“Why do you ask about my Master?”
“I only asked because I wanted to meet him.”
“Why?
Are you close to my Master?”
“Well, he is someone I’ve always respected...”
“If you ever do meet him, don’t say that.
He’ll be offended if a bandit bastard like you pretends to be close to him.
He’ll start by breaking three or four of your ribs.”
“...Your joke is in poor taste.”
“Does it sound like a joke?”
Heavenly Axe bit down hard on his lip and rolled his eyes.
His gaze swept over me, Ju Hwaran and the other members of the Yongbong Escort Bureau, then the faces of the Bermuda Triangle slowly descending the hill.
Finally, his eyes returned to me.
“Then he isn’t here?”
“What if he isn’t?”
“If that’s the case...”
Swish.
Clunk.
Heavenly Axe raised his axe and rested it on his shoulder.
“Then that changes things considerably.”
“Like the way you’re talking now?”
“It was exhausting, humoring a young punk like you.”
“That’s strange.
Nothing seems to have changed whether my Master is here or not.”
“That’s because you’re a greenhorn who knows nothing about the ways of the world.”
“How so?”
“I admit your martial arts are more impressive than I expected.
But don’t make the mistake of thinking you’re your Master’s equal.”
Heavenly Axe raised one hand, his face filled with contempt.
At once, nearly five hundred Green Forest bandits lifted their weapons and stepped forward.
The mere fact that the Fire King was not present seemed to have restored their confidence.
“The Fire King, Jeok Cheongang, is undoubtedly a master beyond the human realm.
But can you really turn the tide of this battle all by yourself?”
“Hmm.”
I looked around.
There were only a little more than seventy people from the Yongbong Escort Bureau.
Half were caravan porters who didn’t know so much as a single move of martial arts, and even the escorts who would have to fight were visibly exhausted.
By contrast, Heavenly Axe commanded nearly five hundred Green Forest bandits.
They had more than ten times as many fighters.
Heavenly Axe certainly had reason to be confident.
But...
“I might as well turn it around while I have the chance.”
“Hahaha!
Go ahead and try.”
“That’s the plan.”
The smile vanished from Heavenly Axe’s lips.
By then, I had already crossed five jang in a single step and thrown my fist.
Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist.
Vroooom.
Compressed air exploded outward.
The wind split, and Extreme Yang heat surged forward.
The same strike that had brought down an unnamed cliff on Mount Song shot toward the five hundred Green Forest bandits massed together like a swarm of ants.
Heavenly Axe stood at their head.
Baaaaang!
A roar split the sky, sending clouds of dust and steam billowing upward.
Ding.
Ding.
Ding.
System notifications continued boring into my ears without pause.
These bandits were too low-Level to grant me any EXP.
I had neither the need nor any reason to use my spear.
I simply unleashed my martial arts indiscriminately at the enemies beyond the chaotic fog.
Baaaaang!
I tore, struck, and smashed everything in my path.
Blood and screams flooded the shattered ground as it heaved like it had been struck by an artillery barrage.
“Gaaaaah!”
“Kill him!”
“He’s over there!”
Whoooosh!
Thud!
Dozens of blades came flying too late and buried themselves in the innocent ground.
Their every movement was sluggish.
I could clearly see the exact path each weapon would take.
This is easy.
Almost bizarrely easy.
Crack!
My own movements, by contrast, were precise and carried tremendous destructive power.
Each time I pressed forward without hesitation, three or four screams rang out.
The panicked bandits could no longer distinguish friend from foe.
They simply swung their weapons like madmen.
Shhk!
Slash!
“Gaaah!
You crazy bastard!”
“W-Wangpal?”
“Yeah, it’s me!
It’s me, you damned bastard!”
“Sorry.
I thought you were him...”
I whispered into the flustered bandit’s ear.
“This time, it is me.”
Crunch!
I seized his neck and twisted with exactly as much force and speed as necessary.
His body crumpled without so much as a scream.
Before it touched the ground, I was already moving again.
Flamefire Path.
The Fire Gate Clan’s signature cultivation technique.
I kicked off the ground and surged forward, a tail of fire piercing the haze.
For an instant, the surroundings lit up, revealing a giant man measuring eight cheok.
Our gazes met through the air.
“There you are.”
“Jin Taekyung, you bastard...”
Grind.
Heavenly Axe ground his teeth as I stepped toward him.
I unleashed the Flame Divine Palm with all my internal energy behind it.
Red qi streamed from the enormous axe Heavenly Axe brought down with the momentum of splitting a person in two.
A lionlike roar burst from his mouth.
“Die!”
Whoooosh!
Boom!
An immense wave of energy whirled outward from the collision.
We were so close that I could feel his breath against my cheek.
My cold, impassive face was reflected in Heavenly Axe’s bulging eyes.
So were the broken axe and my hand, which had pierced through the weapon and his chest to emerge from his back.
Fwoosh!
No blood gushed out like a waterfall.
The heat of the Flame Divine Palm had already vaporized it.
Heavenly Axe’s lips, cracked like a drought-stricken field, moved weakly.
“Y-You... just what...”
“Why?
You told me to turn things around.”
Shhk.
With those words, I pulled my hand from his chest.
His entire body had been burned and melted after he failed to block the opening strike of the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist.
Heavenly Axe looked down at his charred-black chest and muttered in a broken voice.
“This... can’t...”
The unfinished words became Heavenly Axe’s last.
Thud.
As his eight-cheok frame collapsed, a System notification rang out.

chapters.title: Chapter 312
paragraphs: After the bandits of Black Stone Stronghold surrendered, the first person to collect herself was Ju Hwaran, the Young Bureau Head.
She regarded me with an indescribable look in her eyes, then gave me a deep fist-and-palm salute.
“We owe you an immense debt.”
“It was nothing. I was passing by anyway, so I took care of it while I was here.”
I meant it. I had already been on my way through, and it hadn’t taken long. The Level I’d gained was more than enough compensation.
From Ju Hwaran’s perspective, though, I must have seemed like a lifeline.

“If not for Young Hero Jin’s help, every member of the Yongbong Escort Bureau would have left their bones here. I had heard much of the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi’s fame, but it seems the stories of you being a hero who cannot abide injustice were true.”
“A hero? Hardly. That’s just a rumor people spread because it sounds good.”
“Pardon?”
“I can ignore injustice sometimes. I only get rid of people who annoy me every now and then. It just so happens that the people who annoy me are always scumbags—like that Heavenly Axe bastard.”
I glanced at Heavenly Axe’s corpse as a caravan porter dragged it away, then continued.
“And my family runs an Escort Bureau too.”
“Ah, the Jin Family Escort Bureau.”
The Seongun Escort Bureau, once run by the Woo family, had changed its sign to the Jin Family Escort Bureau and was thriving. I’d heard it already had more than five branches.
Shaanxi and Shanxi shared a border, so the Jin Family Escort Bureau and the Yongbong Escort Bureau would probably cross paths someday.
“You know about the Jin Family Escort Bureau. If you ever run into them, please treat them well. Fellow business owners should help each other out, just like today.”
“Fellow business owners?”
“Is there a problem?”
“You do know that the Jin Family Escort Bureau and the Yongbong Escort Bureau are competitors, don’t you?”
Huh? We were competitors?
I blinked and asked again.
“Is that true?”
“You really didn’t know?”
“No. I barely pay attention to family affairs.”
“If you hadn’t saved us today, the Jin Family Escort Bureau might have been able to expand into Shaanxi Province. We may not look like much right now, but we still dominate Shaanxi.”
“I see.”
“This line of work is more cutthroat than it looks. There are plenty of struggles behind the scenes, and armed conflicts break out from time to time.”
“Well, so what if we can’t expand? I’ll tell my eldest brother we should get along with you.”
Ju Hwaran stared at me with an odd expression before letting out a quiet laugh.
“I’d appreciate that.”
Wow. I almost gasped out loud.
All she had done was laugh. How could that be so beautiful?
I swallowed the exclamation rising in my throat just as murmuring voices reached me from behind.
“My word. That’s the first woman I’ve ever seen who’s more beautiful than Young Lady Lee Seowol.”
“Dagger Hidden Flower Ju Hwaran is one of the Three Flowers of Jiangbei. I don’t know who Lee Seowol is, but how could she possibly compare?”
“As if you’re one to talk. Gung Gibang, go scrub yourself on a rock in the stream. That grime is so filthy it makes me sick.”
“What’s wrong with me?”
“You’re a beggar, aren’t you?”
“Hah. That’s true, I suppose.”
An innocent voice followed.
“That’s not true. Young Lady Lee Seowol is pretty too.”
“What’s gotten into Cheongpung? I didn’t know you could say things like that.”
“And Gung Gibang looks pretty to me too.”
“...Then go wash up in the stream with pretty Gung Gibang. Pay special attention to your eyes.”
There was no need to look. It was the Bermuda Triangle.
Normally, I would have at least introduced them, but the level of their conversation was so low that I was embarrassed to say anything.
I was forcing out an awkward cough when Ju Hwaran poked her head past my shoulder.
“Who are those people?”
“I don’t know.”
“You came here together.”
“They’re just traveling companions.”
“Really?”
“I swear it on the heavens.”
I had lowered my voice as much as I could, but the Bermuda Triangle still overheard me. They erupted like wildfire.
“Captain! Are you ashamed of us?”
“Am I embarrassing?”
“Benefactor! I’m fine! Please be ashamed of me!”
“...They’re actually my friends.”
“Anyone can see that.”
Anyone can see that? Somehow, that was even more devastating.
Ju Hwaran laughed softly at my expression, then gave the three of them a fist-and-palm salute.
“I am Ju Hwaran, Young Bureau Head of the Yongbong Escort Bureau. It is an honor to meet my Benefactors.”
I wasn’t sure what those three had done to deserve being called Benefactors, but the Bermuda Triangle bowed their heads anyway.
“I am Hyuk Mujin, one of the great Jin Family of Taiyuan’s foremost elites, Vice Squad Leader of the Jin Dragon Squad, and the right-hand man of the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi.”
I calmly corrected him.
“Not the Vice Squad Leader—the acting Vice Squad Leader. And he isn’t my right hand. He’s more like the pinky on my left.”
Gung Gibang spoke next.
“I am the beggar Gung Gibang.”
“He’s the next-generation beggar boss.”
Finally, it was Cheongpung’s turn.
“Hello! You’re pretty!”
“As you can see, he’s a little unwell. He may not be the sharpest, but he’s a good friend.”
After the whirlwind of introductions and my helpful explanations, Ju Hwaran’s lips parted slightly.
Her large black eyes practically quaked.
“So, let me make sure I understand... The pinky on your left hand, the next-generation beggar boss, and the slightly dim but kind friend?”
“Yes, exactly.”
“I’ve never heard anyone introduced that way before.”
“Would you like me to repeat it?”
“No, thank you.”
She let out a deep sigh, then studied them one by one.
“I, too, have heard of the Swift Wind Sword, who rendered distinguished service during the campaign against the northern mounted bandits.”
Hyuk Mujin stared at Ju Hwaran in bewilderment.
Swift Wind Sword?
I had no idea when he had acquired such a sobriquet, but judging by his reaction, it seemed to be real.
Before anyone could respond, Ju Hwaran continued.
“And the gentleman beside him is Young Hero Gung Gibang, the Successor Beggar and Disciple of Great Hero Myriad-Mile Pursuit, the Beggars’ Sect Leader.”
“P-Pleased to meet you.”

“Lastly, it is an honor to meet Young Hero Cheongpung, the Huashan Divine Dragon. My grandfather and father always spoke of Great Hero Mae Jonghak, the Sword Saint, as a hero of benevolence and righteousness.”
Huashan Divine Dragon was the sobriquet people had given Cheongpung after the Star-Array Grand Banquet.
Cheongpung’s eyes widened in surprise.
“Wow! How do you know all that?”
Ju Hwaran smiled brightly.
“Because I’m the Young Bureau Head of the Yongbong Escort Bureau.”
The answer was brief, but it said a great deal.
We had left Henan only a few days after the Star-Array Grand Banquet ended.
She gathers information quickly.
Unlike Cheongpung and Gung Gibang, Hyuk Mujin was an unknown newcomer who had operated only in Shanxi Province.
The fact that she knew both his name and his sobriquet so precisely meant that Ju Hwaran was even more meticulous and clever than I had expected.
Dagger Hidden Flower. A flower hiding a dagger.
And she had more than one dagger hidden away: Peak-level martial arts, a keen mind, and beauty that could captivate anyone.
She more than deserved her place among the Ten Dragons and Phoenixes, the martial world’s foremost young prodigies.
Interesting. With all that, she should be good at running an Escort Bureau too.
According to Gung Gibang, however, the past two years had brought the Yongbong Escort Bureau one hardship after another.
I shook the question from my mind.
Eh, what difference does it make if I worry about it?
Finding the Divine Physician was more urgent.
We had already lost nearly a shichen here. If we wanted to reach our destination before dawn, we needed to get moving now.
“Young Lady Ju, I think we should be going.”
Ju Hwaran flinched at my sudden declaration.
“Now?”
“I have something urgent to take care of.”
“It’s already so late. Why don’t you spend the night here and leave in the morning...?”
“That might be difficult... We need to reach Xi’an by tomorrow.”
“Ah.”
Ju Hwaran hesitated as though she had something to say, then finally spoke.
“Will I be able to see you again?”
“Of course. If fate brings us together.”
I lowered my head and was about to turn away when Ju Hwaran called after me.
“I will never forget the debt I owe you for saving our lives.”
“I’m not so sure about that. Even if I hadn’t been here, you would have avoided the worst, so you don’t need to be that grateful.”
“What?”
“You would have suffered some losses, of course.”
She still doesn’t know?
Well, that was understandable.
I smiled at the bewildered Ju Hwaran, glanced at the fierce-eyed young escort, and turned away.
System Level 110: Song Ilseom
The Murim really is a vast place. Someone that skilled is working as an escort?
He was the source of the gaze I’d felt this entire time.
Thanks to him, the back of my head had prickled the entire time I was speaking with Ju Hwaran.
But why has that bastard been glaring at me like that? Did I somehow become his sworn enemy?
Apparently, I wasn’t the only one who had noticed his hostile gaze. Cheongpung followed close behind me and whispered.
“Benefactor, did you feel it too?”
“Yeah. I don’t know why he’s acting like that, but he’s being incredibly obvious.”
“Right? Maybe he’s interested in Benefactor.”
Please stop talking bullshit.
The four figures shot away like the wind. As Ju Hwaran watched their backs recede, someone approached her.
“Hwaran.”
“Ah, Uncle Heo.”
Heo Jun had finished binding the bandits and dealing with the aftermath. He followed Ju Hwaran’s gaze and turned his head.
“Jin Taekyung, the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi. He truly is an extraordinary young man. The others are no different.”
“I know. They say rumors from the martial world can’t be trusted... but in this case, they seem to have understated the truth.”
Ju Hwaran recalled the martial prowess Jin Taekyung had displayed.
It had been an overwhelming sight. Watching him had sent a thrill through her, but it had also left her bitter.
If only I had strength like that.
If she had, the Yongbong Escort Bureau would never have ended up in its current state.
Ju Hwaran swallowed the words on the tip of her tongue and spoke. This time, she sent them through Sound Transmission, carrying them on her internal energy.
—Uncle Heo. Keep an eye on Escort Captain Song.
Heo Jun was seasoned enough to be the Chief Escort. Without revealing anything on his face, he brought up another subject and replied through Sound Transmission.
—Hwaran. Are you suggesting...?
—It’s only a suspicion for now. But too many things don’t add up.
The leak of confidential information about the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng. The attacks that had continued without pause for the past four months.
Ju Hwaran intended to cut out the betrayal that had taken root deep within the bureau.
Especially the last thing Jin Taekyung said.
He had said that even without him, the worst would never have happened.
That meant there was a master within the Yongbong Escort Bureau capable of easily defeating Heavenly Axe and handling the enemies.
And... that look in his eyes.
It had lasted only an instant, but she had seen it clearly.
Jin Taekyung’s gaze had lingered on Song Ilseom as he turned away.
And his eyes had held a faint trace of surprise.
There’s definitely something going on.
Ju Hwaran suddenly thought back over the past two years—the countless failures she had endured while leading the Escort Bureau before she had even turned twenty.
What if those failures had come from trusting people too easily? What if someone had betrayed her?
What was she supposed to do then?
Whoooosh.
As the cold wind whipped around her, Ju Hwaran stood there for a long time.
“Could you provide me with a quiet room?”
The man was dressed in white. He was strikingly handsome, and his words and manner were so courteous that anyone who heard him would find it difficult to refuse.
He brought to mind a proud, solitary crane, and the Captain of the Guards standing at the entrance found himself wondering.
Who is he? I’ve never seen him before.
Xi’an Tower was, as its name suggested, one of Xi’an’s foremost pleasure houses.
Staying there required not only money, but also the status to match. As a result, its guests tended to be the same familiar faces.
But he’s a young man who came alone, without a carriage or servants...
Under normal circumstances, he would have been turned away without a second thought.
Yet something about the young man nagged at him. That was why the Captain of the Guards had dismissed his subordinates and come to receive him personally.
“Have you visited our pleasure house before?”
“No. My circumstances don’t permit such luxuries.”
The young man smiled sheepishly and rubbed his cheek.
The Captain of the Guards’ eyes widened.
That’s...!
Pale crimson blossoms had been embroidered on the young man’s snow-white sleeve.
They were unmistakably plum blossoms in full bloom.
A stammer slipped from between the guard captain’s lips.
“M-May I ask your honored name?”
“I’m a Daoist named Baek Museong.”
“H-Huashan’s Lone Crane!”
Baek Museong, direct Disciple of Huashan Sect Leader Heavenly Sword True Person, smiled faintly.
